name: Claim held up by five numbers across a rule
useWhen: A claim needing five pieces of quantitative proof, where the claim is what the room should leave with.

focal.note: The numerals dominate, but the claim at 64px holds its own — which is why the claim is set at display weight rather than as a 40px headline. Drop the claim to headline size and the slide becomes a stat dump.

replacesNote: stats-v1 lines four numerals in one row over a ruler and leaves the middle of the canvas empty. This wraps five numbers around a claim and fills. Do not retire stats-v1 until this has been through a real deck.

deviations.why: The source carries a faint full-bleed dot texture. Reproducing it is a §5 dot-system decision affecting every slide's ground, not a template one.

The source carries a full-bleed dot texture this template does not reproduce (a §5 dot-system decision, not a template one). The composition check reads that texture as ink, so it FAILs here and passes there. Not a dead lower half — measured, and the gap is the texture.
